prompts.name: robot_analysis_template
prompts.title: Run structural calculations
prompts.description: Sets up FEA analysis: checks calculation status first, confirms AllowHeavyOperations, then runs project.CalcEngine.Calculate().

arguments.name: task
arguments.description: Analysis task, e.g. 'run structural calculations and check reaction forces'

prompts.name: toolify_run
prompts.title: Package a run as a tool
prompts.description: Loads the code and literal analysis of a past execute_<host>_code run and instructs the model to generalise it into a registry tool.

arguments.name: runId
arguments.description: runId returned by the execute tool (execute_revit_code / execute_autocad_code)

prompts.name: robot_query_template
prompts.title: Query the Robot model
prompts.description: Sets up a read-only investigation of the open Robot model: values returned by a script with transaction="none".

arguments.name: question
arguments.description: What the user wants to inspect in the model, e.g. 'how many bars are there and what sections do they use?'

prompts.name: robot_modify_template
prompts.title: Modify the Robot model
prompts.description: Sets up a writing change (draw bars, assign supports or sections, apply loads): context first, static preview with dryRun=true, then apply with transaction="auto".

arguments.name: task
arguments.description: The modification task, e.g. 'create a column from (0,0,0) to (0,0,4) and assign HEA 300'
